name: caption-stack
title: Caption Stack
description: Kinetic captions stacked a couple of words per line, with the keyword of each page set large on its own line.
useWhen: Short-form video where the captions are part of the design: each page reads as a small typographic poster and the word that matters is the biggest thing on it.
You know which words carry the message and want them to land harder than the rest: pass them as keywords and each one takes a line of its own.
avoidWhen: The voice should be followed one word at a time in the middle of the frame: use caption-word-pop.
Captions must sit quietly in the bottom third and never grow taller than a line or two: use caption-subtitle.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Captions
variables.description: Word timings as JSON: [{"text","startMs","endMs"}] in milliseconds, or [{"text","start","end"}] in seconds. A transcript from Mosio works as is.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Caption text size in pixels (at 1080 px on the short side).

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words that start within this window share one page of captions. A sentence end always starts a new page.

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: How long the last page stays after its final word.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Soft shadow behind the text for legibility on footage.

variables.label: Keywords
variables.description: Comma-separated words that take a line of their own, large and in the accent color. Leave empty to use the longest word on each page.

variables.label: Emphasis scale
variables.description: Size of a keyword line relative to the rest.
